messages:
deploybot: deploy-check detected environment parity failure for service="inference-runtime". Blocking release 3045678901.
deploybot: details:
```
path: /etc/service/config.json
staging_hash: sha256:3f4a9b...
prod_hash: sha256:7c9d2e...
diff_keys: secrets.seed.encoding
notes: staging saved seed as base64, prod saved seed as hex string
```
alice: ugh. pinging @dana and @ben, this is during the 18:00 release window. :warning:
ben: on it. can someone dump the secret values from prod+staging? quick `kubectl -n inference get secret inference-config -o json`?
carol: i pulled them, confirmed different encodings. staging: `c2VjcmV0c2VlZA==` (base64) vs prod: `73656372657473656564` (hex).
dana: that explains the hash mismatch. is this from the migration we ran last week? :thinking:
alice: yes, migration v2.4 changed the seed serialization. looks like prod rollout didn't update the storage encoder.
ben: two immediate options: 1) normalize prod secrets to base64 to match staging (fast), 2) pin the deployment to previous image tag until we fix upstream encoder and roll forward (safer).
release-coordinator: we have a hard change window until 19:00 UTC. If we can't fix in 30m we should rollback to keep SLA.
carol: i can do a one-off normalization script but need confirmation for KMS decrypt/re-encrypt path. It will touch prod secrets - requesting approval.
dana: approval granted for emergency normalization if it only touches the encoding and not key material. @carol proceed and report back. :+1:
carol: running local validation now. plan:
```
# fetch
kubectl -n inference get secret inference-config -o jsonpath='{.data.secrets\.seed}' | base64 -d > seed.raw
# detect hex vs base64
python detect_and_reencode.py --input seed.raw --to base64 | base64 | kubectl patch secret inference-config -n inference -p '{\"data\":{\"secrets.seed\":\"REPLACEME==\"}}'
```
ben: also add a release note and update the rollout plan to pin image if normalization fails. i'll open the rollback PR now to pin to `inference-runtime@v1.12.3`.
before-ben: (automated) opened PR https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/2891 pin runtime to v1.12.3
carol: patch applied to prod (encoding normalized). running smoke tests against canary.
alice: canary looks good, latency/errs within baseline. :eyes:
dana: keep release on hold until we complete postdeploy verification. notify docs to mention the encoding quirk for future migrations.
release-coordinator: decision: HOLD release for 30m while we validate. If no regressions, we will promote. If further parity diffs appear, we roll back to v1.12.3.
ben: adding an eval to the release notes and alerting support to watch tokenization edge cases.
carol: final check done. canary OK. marking deploybot check as resolved.
deploybot: Block cleared: parity check passed after secret encoding normalization. Release can proceed when release-coordinator unpauses.
release-coordinator: thanks everyone. proceeding with manual promote at 18:25 UTC. Updating the release notes: "Hotfix: normalize secret encoding after migration caused staging/prod parity failure; pinned runtime to v1.12.3 as fallback."
alice: logging a postmortem ticket and a follow-up to add an automated hook to detect encoding mismatches earlier: https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/4120
ben: nice work. closing thread after release completes. :shipit:
